task.title: Replace overlapping story agents with Narrative Craft
task.source: Direct request to reduce recurring AI-shaped fiction without slowing replies
task.classification: engine generation, prompt policy, background work, agent compatibility, and roleplay UI

coreClaim: Narrative Craft analyzes completed roleplay replies only when a cheap recurrence trigger matches, stores exact-evidence guidance for one later reply, and never delays or competes with foreground generation.
rootCause: Prose Guardian, Director, and Secret Plot split overlapping story-shaping concerns across blocking or independently stateful agents without a selective, measured next-turn correction contract.

inScope: One Narrative Craft built-in replacing the three legacy story agents
Cheap recurring-shape trigger and detached critic execution
Exact-evidence validation and consume-once next-turn guidance
Bounded per-chat story state and legacy Secret Plot conversion
Foreground priority through the shared background-generation coordinator
Narrative Craft inspector and agent settings
outOfScope: Rewriting the reply that was already shown
Detector evasion promises or production StoryScope scoring
Migrating or deleting legacy agent records

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Only validated guidance derived from exact excerpts in completed assistant prose can affect one later roleplay reply; clean, exempt, cancelled, malformed, Conversation, and Game paths keep their prior writer behavior.
claimBoundary.riskType: prompt, provider, persistence, background concurrency, defaults, and legacy compatibility
entrypoints: Legacy Prose Guardian, Director, and Secret Plot activation
outOfScopeClaims: No claim that every instance of AI-shaped prose is detected.
No claim that StoryScope represents real reader preference by itself.
No claim that the detached critic has zero token or quota cost.
No claim that the planted-control activation rate predicts user-chat prevalence.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: The old story agents could overlap, add foreground work, and shape prose without a single exact-evidence, next-turn-only owner.
contractLaneGate.producer: The roleplay writer and completed saved assistant response
contractLaneGate.consumer: The next roleplay prompt assembly and Narrative Craft inspector
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Story guidance should be sparse, grounded in completed assistant prose, nonblocking, compatible with existing chats, and unable to delay a new foreground reply.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: src/engine owns trigger, critic, state, exact-evidence validation, consume-once injection, legacy remapping, and foreground cancellation; React exposes inspection and controls only.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: Engine generation owns completed output, background scheduling, provider resolution, state persistence, and the next-turn prompt boundary.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not rewrite saved prose in React, run the critic before the writer, accept paraphrased evidence, or keep three competing story-policy agents active.
regressionProof: Focused engine suites prove trigger controls, exact evidence, coalescing, cancellation, consume-once state, legacy mapping, and default creation.
The expanded two-family shadow corpus measures StoryScope, blind quality, false positives, and detached latency.

riskClaimMatrix.coreClaim: Narrative Craft improves repeated story-shape behavior without adding foreground latency or overriding intentional prose choices.
entrypoints: Existing roleplay chats with explicit agent selections
legacyPathsOrFormats: Legacy story agent ids and memory
positiveRowsTested: 52 completed accepted intervention pairs across GLM-5.2 and GPT-5.6 Terra
Exact evidence accepted from prior and current assistant turns
Consume-once guidance injected into a later reply
Legacy ids resolve to one Narrative Craft instance
New roleplay chats persist Narrative Craft as the only detached default
negativeRowsTested: Requested ritual, chorus, formal refrain, and clean resolution
Foreground generation aborts queued and in-flight critics

groundTruthFacts.description: The critic is outside the reply-producing path.
groundTruthFacts.evidence: The start-generation integration test reaches the visible done event before the critic starts, and the shared foreground lease tests defer and abort critic work.

groundTruthFacts.description: Only exact assistant excerpts can authorize guidance.
groundTruthFacts.evidence: The evaluation harness and engine tests reject subject substitutions, paraphrases, and evidence absent from completed assistant prose.

groundTruthFacts.description: The completed intervention subset improved both evaluation gates.
groundTruthFacts.evidence: Across 52 pairs, StoryScope favored treatment 34 to 18 and blind judges preferred treatment 61 to 42 with one tie.

manualBlockers.reason: The tracked corpus is synthetic by design so private user prose is not retained; production can count content-free activation and cancellation diagnostics.

positiveRows.claim: Accepted interventions improve the measured StoryScope direction across two model families.
positiveRows.evidence: The full-feature classifier favored treatment 34 to 18 across 52 completed pairs, with mean treatment-minus-baseline estimated human probability of +0.1298.

positiveRows.claim: Blind quality is non-inferior and directionally better.
positiveRows.evidence: Independent judges preferred treatment 61 times, baseline 42 times, and tied once.
The critic starts only after visible completion, waits on the shared foreground lease, and is aborted across chats when a new foreground turn starts.

positiveRows.claim: New roleplay chats receive Narrative Craft without enabling unrelated foreground agents.
positiveRows.evidence: The creation schema tests persist only narrative-craft for roleplay and add no agent to Conversation or Game.

contradictionRows.claim: A requested stylistic or story choice must not be treated as a defect merely because it resembles a category.
contradictionRows.evidence: Prompt contracts and 14 negative-control evaluations cover formal repetition, personified settings, direct emotion, procedures, and continuing danger.

contradictionRows.claim: A paraphrased quotation must not create guidance.
contradictionRows.evidence: Exact-evidence tests reject subject substitutions and absent excerpts.

contradictionRows.claim: A new reply must not wait for prior critic work.
contradictionRows.evidence: Shared coordinator and Narrative Craft scheduler tests prove deferral and cross-chat abort behavior.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Legacy story-agent activation does not run three agents.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Agent contract tests normalize Prose Guardian, Director, Secret Plot, and Narrative Craft ids to one Narrative Craft activation.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing explicit chat selections remain unchanged.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Default activation occurs only through new-roleplay-chat schema creation; existing chat metadata and presets are not migrated.

untestedRows: No private live-user prose was collected, so the synthetic planted-control activation rate is not a production prevalence estimate.
No manual app-browser screenshot was captured for the inspector panel; component tests cover visibility, retry, and memory clearing.

ownedFacts.description: Narrative Craft uses its configured connection and model, then the default Agent connection, then the chat writer connection.
ownedFacts.evidence: agent-runner resolves agent.connectionId and agent.model before the default Agent and chat connection fallbacks.

ownedFacts.description: A cancelled or failed critic creates no pending guidance.
ownedFacts.evidence: Scheduler and state tests cover cancellation, failure containment, and consume-once pending guidance.

manualBlockers.reason: Synthetic held-out controls establish selectivity and quality direction without retaining private chat content.
The core claim is engine behavior; focused component tests cover the panel actions and no layout claim is made.

verification.baselineEvidence: The current-main branch passed 2,502 frontend tests with one skipped, focused Narrative Craft and coordinator tests, TypeScript, architecture, docs, storage contracts, Rust workspace compilation, repository checks, external harness unit tests, and git diff whitespace checks.
afterEvidence: pnpm vitest run focused Narrative Craft, chat creation, coordinator, pipeline, and lifecycle suites

notes: The user explicitly authorized commit, push, PR creation, merge to main, and Pi deployment.
The synthetic evaluation corpus contains no user-chat content.

Durable test rationale: prompt grounding, consume-once persistence, compatibility remapping, default activation, and foreground cancellation are risky invariants that can regress silently; the tests are narrow at their engine or component owner boundaries.
